description: Read or stream logs from every context of a running dev session (service worker, content scripts, popup, options, sidebar, devtools, pages) in one ordered timeline. This reads the same agent-bridge plane as the `extension logs` CLI: a one-shot returns the most recent matching lines from logs.ndjson, and follow:true connects to the live control channel, receives the broker's replay of its recent ring (up to 5,000 events, counted in value.replayed) and then the frames that arrive during followMs (value.live). This requires an active extension_dev session.

browser.description: Which dist/extension-js/<browser>/ to read. Defaults to this project's live session, else chrome. Required when the project runs sessions for more than one browser.

context.description: Restrict to these contexts. Omit for all.

follow.description: Collect from the live control channel for a bounded window instead of reading the file.

followMs.description: How long to collect live frames when follow=true (clamped 500–15000ms).

level.description: Minimum severity; a level includes everything more severe.

limit.description: How many of the most recent events to return.

projectPath.description: Extension project root (needs a live dev session)

signalsOnly.description: Only structured dx.signal diagnostics (code/status/remediation), no plain console lines.

since.description: Only events with seq greater than this; the cursor for polling forward.

tab.description: Only events from this tab id.

url.description: Only events whose url/hostname matches (glob or substring), e.g. https://shop.example/*.

name: extension_logs
